1.name: OE#
1.hint: output enable, active low (Table 7-1): low – Y follows A; high – Y high impedance. Must not float (5.3 note 1); tied to GND the output always drives, TI asks for a pull-up to VCC where Y must stay high impedance during power-up (7.1)

2.name: A
2.hint: data input with TTL thresholds (VIH 2.0 V, VIL 0.8 V at VCC 4.5–5.5 V, 5.3); takes up to 5.5 V at any valid VCC (8.2.2) – a 3.3 V output drives it, the up-translation of Figure 8-1

4.name: Y
4.hint: 3-state output: high impedance while OE is high (Table 7-1); ±8 mA recommended (5.3), ±25 mA absolute maximum (5.1); VOH ≥ 3.8 V at −8 mA and ≥ 4.4 V at −50 µA (VCC 4.5 V, −40…125 °C, 5.5); must not be pulled above VCC (8.2.2)

hints: 5 V part: VCC 4.5–5.5 V (5.3) – fed from a 5 V rail that can sag below 4.5 V (USB behind a diode) it leaves its specified range
single supply: a 0.1 µF bypass capacitor as close to VCC as possible (8.3)
input transition rate ≤ 20 ns/V (5.3); tPLH/tPHL ≤ 7 ns at 15 pF and ≤ 9.5 ns at 50 pF over −40…125 °C (5.6)
continuous current through VCC or GND ±50 mA (5.1)
icc_a 1.5 mA: ΔICC with one input at a TTL level (3.4 V, VCC 5.5 V, 5.5) – the supply current while a 3.3 V output holds A high; with A at 0 V or VCC ICC ≤ 10 µA
